mostWorthwhile.text: Threading the loop onto the spinner was most worthwhile: it brought the parts together and revealed the motion of the finished creation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the battery and switch felt fairly routine, although the goals and described changes were clear.

surprise.text: Seeing the red section travel around the loop clarified what the wheel and string do together.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the fork and closed loop both had apparent roles in the finished spinner.

continue.text: I might continue to see another working mechanism, though the largely prescribed fitting sequence offers limited decisions. Text alone cannot establish how recognizable the artwork is or how the toy feels to handle.
